messages:
riley: FYI - eu-west4 ephemeral NVMe showing metadata checksum churn during concurrent scrub + image-pull window. observed attach failures for a handful of GPU pods. infra-bot alerted.
infra-bot: [ALERT] nvme_meta_checksum_errors > 50 (eu-west4) - 10m rolling. see /dash/nvme-meta and runbook /runbooks/meta-checks.md
tom: digging in. pattern: janitor deep-scrub touched hot files at same time as parallel batch reclaim. controllers reported queue-full on a few hosts. pending GPU allocs ~27.
priya: scrub config for eu-west4 was bumped to aggressive mode last deploy (deep=true). that probably amplified metadata IO.
dan: proposal: flip deep-scrub=false for region, reduce scrub_concurrency to 3, and enable per-pod backpressure on janitor so it yields on >75% nvme_io. scope to eu-west4 only.
riley: agree. small blast radius. post exact kubectl flags.
ops-svc: hotpatch commands (eu-west4 namespace):
```
kubectl set env deployment/janitor JANITOR_DEEP_SCRUB=false -n infra-eu-west4
kubectl set env deployment/janitor JANITOR_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=3 -n infra-eu-west4
kubectl annotate deployment/janitor ops/runbook=meta-throttle -n infra-eu-west4
```
Applying now.
[tom reacts :white_check_mark:]
infra-bot: [ACTION] janitor env patched by ops-svc (JANITOR_DEEP_SCRUB=false, JANITOR_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=3)
priya: also toggled local-image-cache=warm for 60m to reduce read amplification.
dan: initial telemetry: meta checksum errors dropped from 78 -> 6 in ~9m, attach pending down 27 -> 3. good signal.
riley: would we like to spill a small portion to ap-northeast1 while backlog drains? cost estimate ~+$95/hr for 10% spill. finance ok for emergency short window.
tom: let's avoid spill unless numbers regress. prefer a scheduled safe-mode for janitor during peak hours until RFC lands.
priya: opening ticket PMT-8912 for postmortem and RFC: /docs/rfcs/region-scoped-scrub-policies.md
ops-svc: leaving increased alerting sensitivity for 2h and reverting flags after 60m if stable.
dan: follow-ups: add a low-latency backoff trigger in janitor codepath and add a canary gate for deep-scrub changes.
riley: scheduling retro with scheduler/janitor/firmware owners tomorrow 10:00am. thanks everyone, nice quick patch. :thumbsup:
